The network game structure can be learned from the observed play of a game on a network.

(a) the structure of the network game can be inferred from the observed actions of the players, (b) the inference can be performed efficiently, and (c) the structure can be used to predict the players' actions in future rounds of the game.

(1) the structure of network games can be learned from the observed actions of the players, (2) the learning process is fast and robust, and (3) the learning process can be used to infer the structure of the network, even in the case where players are myopic and only play best response to their observed neighbors' actions
